title: Blessing of the Naaru (Part 3)
flavor: When Orc Invaders filled with demonic blood slayed Draenei cities with no mercy, exiled Draenei bounty hunters are forced to holed up everywhere and conceal themselves despite the faith of Holy Light. At last they made a dishonorable way to recapture their homeland, by helping their enemy’s enemy. But Illidari never intended to share Draenei’s homeland with them after the overwhelming victory. After the initial despair, Bounty Hunter Gondar are waiting for a new chance for revenge. “I paid for my miscalculation, but all I need is to keep patient. The moment will come, when betrayers get betrayed finally…”

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
entries.detail: Synergies updated from Goblin/Assassin to Goblin/Draenei/Assassin.

entries.name: Faceless Void
entries.detail: Ability Reworked into Time Zone Ability: Time Zone <Active Skill: Activate on Full Mana> Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, attack, cast projectile, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and enemies have decreased speed. Enemies are leashed inside the Time Zone.

entries.name: Terrorblade - Metamorphosis
entries.detail: Now demonic Terrorblade will be no higher than the rank of Terrorblade. Ability:  Metamorphosis <Active Skill: Activate on Full Mana> Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demonic form with a ranged attack, removing most of the status effects from himself. Rank 2 or higher Terrorblade also transforms his nearest ally into a demon with a rank equal to the transformed chess piece(no higher than the rank of Terrorblade).
